summary: Remove a filesystem directory entry with Node unlink semantics.

semantics.mutation: removes file/symlink directory entry; does not recursively remove directories

caveats: File.Delete is not equivalent because .NET can silently succeed for a missing path.
Unlinking a symlink removes the link, not its target.

tests.name: removes file
tests.expected_behavior: returns undefined and the file entry no longer exists

tests.name: missing throws
tests.expected_behavior: throws a Node-compatible ENOENT-style error instead of silently succeeding
